name: B10-0284/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Case of Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It calls for Iran to release Ahmadreza Djalali, a Swedish-Iranian doctor held since 2016 and at risk of execution, and all other foreign and dual nationals held arbitrarily. It condemns Iran's heavy use of the death penalty and what it calls hostage diplomacy, and asks the European Union to sanction those responsible and support Iranian civil society.

- The text changes no law; it is the Parliament's opinion and set of demands to Iran and the European Union.
- It concerns Ahmadreza Djalali, other detained foreign and dual nationals, and Iranian officials who could face sanctions.
- Next, the Parliament sends the text to European Union institutions, member states and Iran; follow-up depends on them.
